bead.title: Stage TP-003 PR gate runner without hard coverage flip
bead.description:
Purpose: make TP-003 PR gate mechanics available without red-lining the current queue before coverage bars are proven in the release lane.

This bead stages coverage in report-only mode. The release orchestrator bead is the required successor that flips per-PR coverage enforcement after the bars are proven.

In-scope files:
- .github/workflows/ci.yml
- scripts/ci/pr-gate.sh
- scripts/ci/coverage-report.sh
- scripts/ci/property-fuzz-smoke.sh
- docs/helix/06-iterate/BUILD-001-implementation-plan.md only for an optional note about staged coverage enforcement

Out of scope: hard coverage fail-under enforcement; release/nightly orchestration.
bead.acceptance:
1. `bash scripts/ci/pr-gate.sh --mode bootstrap` runs fmt, clippy, test, cargo-deny, cargo-machete, coverage report without fail-under, and property/fuzz smoke.
2. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` calls `scripts/ci/pr-gate.sh --mode bootstrap` for pull requests.
3. The coverage report prints pqueue-core line/branch coverage and pqueue-service line coverage but does not fail under thresholds in this bead.
4. The bead implementation or docs note names the release orchestrator bead as the required successor that flips per-PR coverage enforcement.
